method.quantity: Exact FAOSTAT item and tonne; no conversion or aggregation across product forms.
method.gross_import_share_pct: Imports / (production + imports - exports) × 100; requires all three quantities. Can exceed 100% for re-exporters; not net dependence.
method.estimated_cover_months: Opening-stock estimate / apparent domestic availability × 12; not measured reserves, not a forecast, and not used to rank risks. Where the provider's newest figure is a rounding error beside that country's own recent history, or a large buyer is recorded as holding under a week of use, no figure is published and the reason is given instead.
method.supplier_share: Share of observed bilateral flows, not all imports. If the balance year has no trade evidence, up to three prior years may be shown separately; coverage is withheld for mismatched years. Importer report preferred, mirror fallback.
method.food_price_gap: National food CPI growth minus general CPI growth; not commodity-specific.
method.healthy_diet_unaffordable: FAO modelled national estimate, not commodity-specific.
method.status: Annual structural evidence, not a current alert.
